origin_of_intent.near: acts on this machine alone, no further data needed
far: list of one or more destination identifiers -- mac, ip, body name, or named service -- this intent reaches toward

transport_protocol.http: existing per-route request/response bodies, unchanged, for every LAN-open caller that isn't Arcadia

socket.framing: 4-byte big-endian length prefix, then this envelope as UTF-8 JSON

lanes.request-response: one frame in, one frame out, correlated by intent_id
lanes.subscribe-push: one subscribe frame in, zero or more push frames out over the life of the connection, on the truth_recomputation_cadence
